entities.summary: Marcos, a notable figure in the history of Venezuela, associated with Oil, Dictatorship, and Democracy (1935–1958). Preceded by Venezuela becomes world's largest oil exporter and Barroso II blowout announces Venezuela's oil wealth — December 14, 1922. Their legacy influenced Trienio Adeco — first democratic experiment — 1945 and Popular uprising overthrows Pérez Jiménez — January 23, 1958.
